title: La petite voiture de Léo
author: Librito Example
style: Children's watercolor storybook illustration, soft expressive brushwork, warm natural light, gentle pastel colors, cozy home interiors, and charming storybook aesthetics

concepts.description: A 5-year-old boy with fair skin, short tousled dark brown hair, bright expressive dark eyes, and a cheerful round face, wearing a plain white crewneck t-shirt and light beige casual trousers.
A small bright red vintage toy race car with a smooth glossy rounded body, small black wheels, and a thin white racing stripe painted along the top. No visible number in the body.
A cozy, bright family living room with light oak parquet floors, pale cream walls, soft sheer curtains letting in warm daylight, and a large comfortable fabric sofa with soft cushions.

illustration.prompt: Storybook cover illustration featuring <LEO> happily playing on the floor with his <TOY_CAR> in the warm daylight of the <LIVING_ROOM>. The title "La petite voiture de Léo" is beautifully and clearly written in storybook lettering at the top.
A small charming watercolor spot illustration of the <TOY_CAR> centered on a clean light surface with a soft delicate shadow, surrounded by generous empty space.

text: Une histoire douce et lumineuse autour d'un petit garçon et de sa voiture rouge préférée.

illustration.prompt: A peaceful and sun-drenched view of the deserted <LIVING_ROOM>, with afternoon light streaming through the sheer curtains, illuminating the sofa and warm wooden floor, with house plants on shelves and a gentle tranquil home ambiance. Resting on the floor near the sofa is the <TOY_CAR>. In the upper left of the image, the teaser text is clearly and beautifully written in storybook lettering: "Une histoire douce et lumineuse autour d'un petit garçon et de sa voiture rouge préférée."

scenes.label: scene_01
scenes.text: Ce matin-là, Léo ne trouve plus sa petite voiture rouge. Il la cherche partout : sous son lit, dans son grand coffre à jouets et derrière les rideaux du salon. Mais la petite voiture reste introuvable.
scenes.prompt: <LEO> searches anxiously around the <LIVING_ROOM>, peeking behind the light sheer curtains with a puzzled and focused expression, looking for his lost toy.

scenes.label: scene_02
scenes.text: En s'approchant du grand canapé, Léo soulève un gros coussin moelleux. La voilà ! Sa petite voiture rouge est là, bien cachée. Un large sourire illumine son visage.
scenes.prompt: <LEO> stands by the comfortable sofa in the <LIVING_ROOM>, joyfully lifting a large soft cushion to reveal the <TOY_CAR> hidden underneath, his face beaming with a delighted smile.

scenes.label: scene_03
scenes.text: Tout joyeux, Léo file dans sa chambre pour jouer. Il fait rouler son bolide sur le parquet, invente des circuits autour des pieds de chaise et trace des virages le long du tapis toute la matinée.
scenes.prompt: <LEO> happily kneeling on the wooden floor of his bright cozy child bedroom, pushing his <TOY_CAR> along the edge of a colorful play rug around wooden chair legs with pure excitement.

scenes.label: scene_04
scenes.text: Une délicieuse odeur de gâteaux vient chatouiller son nez. Léo redescend au salon, où sa maman a préparé de bons biscuits dorés. Il les savoure avec bonheur, sa précieuse voiture rouge bien serrée dans la main.
scenes.prompt: <LEO> sitting happily at a small wooden table in the sunlit <LIVING_ROOM>, holding his beloved <TOY_CAR> firmly in one hand while enjoying freshly baked golden cookies from a ceramic plate, warm maternal presence nearby.
